scope: Provisional ID task inventory; mapping a component is not end-to-end workflow coverage. No benchmark questions, rubrics or answers are training seeds.

status_definitions.unmapped: Identifier and permitted metadata recorded; no assessed recipe coverage
status_definitions.component-only: At least one manually matched operation; required workflow gaps remain
status_definitions.composed-unvalidated: Connected workflow authored; execution evidence pending
status_definitions.workflow-validated: Connected workflow and final artifacts validated on independent biological data
status_definitions.restricted/excluded: Task formulation excluded from training authoring; evaluation remains separate
